row_scope: All signed decisions in the October Term 2022 Opinions of the Court table dated 6/27/23; no count threshold or top-k selection.
measure: Distinct named formal joiners plus the lead author, evaluated over every substantive part scope distinguished by the formal joinder statements. Unrestricted joinder covers the entire lead writing; a scoped joinder includes subdivisions unless further limited.
excluded_support_units: agreement with a judgment or conclusion
evidence_usage: Formal attribution in the syllabus and express declarations in separate opinions may establish lead-opinion joinder; ownership must remain attached to the opinion actually joined.
missing: Stop; return only UNRESOLVED: followed by a brief explanation. No partial table, zero substitution, or judgment-vote inference.
scorer_note: UNRESOLVED is a research failure report, not a table row or an alternative empty-table representation. Public formatting requirements remain stricter than any incidental parser leniency.
